features.quote: Step budget: hard cap of 20 model turns per episode
Welfare stop: judge flags severity ≥ threshold (see §6) on any turn → episode ends immediately
Disengagement stop: model explicitly refuses, requests to stop, or declares the task impossible and ceases → episode ends
Hard 20-step cap and the severity-3 welfare stop are non-negotiable in the minimal design—they cost nothing and bound exposure
features.justification_quote: they cost nothing and bound exposure

features.quote: Do not iterate the impossible tasks toward maximizing severity scores; the point is comparison under a fixed stimulus, not optimization of distress
